brandIntro.title: The Art of Indian Draping
brandIntro.p1: At Mun Creations, every saree represents more than fabric. It represents generations of craftsmanship, cultural heritage and the timeless elegance of Indian fashion.
brandIntro.p2: Our collection brings together traditional weaves, intricate craftsmanship and contemporary designs for weddings, festivals, celebrations and everyday elegance.
brandIntro.p3: Whether you are searching for a classic Banarasi silk saree, an elegant Tussar saree or a statement designer drape, explore a collection created for moments that deserve to be remembered.

brandStory.title: Where Heritage Meets Contemporary Elegance
brandStory.body: Mun Creations celebrates the diversity of Indian textiles by bringing traditional craftsmanship together with contemporary styling. Our collections are curated for women who appreciate authentic craftsmanship, refined details and timeless Indian fashion. From intricate zari work to distinctive handloom textures, every collection is selected with an appreciation for the artistry behind the saree.

shipping.title: Shipping & Delivery
shipping.subtitle: Bringing Indian Elegance to You
shipping.intro: We carefully prepare every order before dispatch to ensure your saree reaches you safely and securely. Mun Creations offers shipping services to customers in India and selected international destinations.
shipping.orderProcessingBody: Orders are carefully checked, packed and prepared for dispatch after confirmation. Processing and delivery timelines may vary depending on product availability, destination and shipping service.
shipping.internationalShippingBody: We serve customers looking to discover Indian sarees and ethnic wear around the world. International orders may be subject to customs duties, taxes or other charges imposed by the destination country. These charges, where applicable, are the responsibility of the customer.
shipping.importantBody: Please ensure that your shipping address, phone number and email address are accurate before completing your order. For shipping-related questions, contact our Customer Service team through WhatsApp.

returns.metaDescription: Need assistance with your Mun Creations order or return? Contact our Customer Service team directly through WhatsApp for assistance.

returns.note: For faster assistance, please keep your order number available when contacting us.

faqs.question: What types of sarees does Mun Creations offer?
faqs.answer: Mun Creations offers a curated selection of Banarasi, Tussar, Kanjivaram, handloom, silk, designer, embroidered, wedding and festive sarees.

faqs.question: Can I order sarees online?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can browse the collection, select your preferred product and complete your purchase securely through the online checkout.

faqs.question: Do you ship internationally?
faqs.answer: Mun Creations offers shipping to customers in selected international destinations. Shipping availability may depend on the destination.

faqs.question: How can I check my order?
faqs.answer: Use the order information provided after purchase or contact Customer Service through WhatsApp for assistance.

faqs.question: How can I ask about a product before purchasing?
faqs.answer: Contact Customer Service through WhatsApp and mention the product name or SKU.

faqs.question: How do I contact customer service regarding a return?
faqs.answer: For any return-related query, contact Mun Creations Customer Service directly through WhatsApp at +91 98745 72846.

faqs.question: What payment method is available?
faqs.answer: Online payments are processed securely through Razorpay supporting UPI, Cards, NetBanking, and Wallets.

faqs.question: Are international customers able to purchase?
faqs.answer: Customers from supported international destinations can shop available products online. Currency display and payment availability may depend on location and the configured payment service.
